# @zakkster/lite-scrollforge

Zero-GC, zero-dependency single-file ESM authoring layer for CSS Scroll-Driven
Animations. Compile storyboards to native CSS, GSAP, or lite-scroll-rig-pro
code; drop-in polyfill runtime for browsers without native support.

## Install

    npm i @zakkster/lite-scrollforge

## Minimal example

    import { attachStoryboardRuntime } from '@zakkster/lite-scrollforge';

    attachStoryboardRuntime({
        tracks: [{
            selector: '.hero-title',
            timeline: { kind: 'view' },
            range: { start: 'entry 0%', end: 'entry 100%' },
            keyframes: [
                { opacity: 0, translateY: 30 },
                { opacity: 1, translateY: 0 }
            ],
            easing: 'easeOutCubic'
        }]
    });

## Exports (15 total; 13 canonical, 2 deprecated aliases)

Core (CSS emission):
    trackToCss(track)              -> { keyframesName, keyframesCss, ruleCss }
    storyboardToCss(sb, opts?)     -> string
    attachStoryboard(sb, root?)    -> { detach, styleElement }
    resetKeyframeCounter()
    HAS_NATIVE_SUPPORT             -> boolean

Easings + CSS Level 4 linear():
    CSS_EASINGS                    -> frozen Record<string, string>  (29 entries)
    EASINGS                        -> alias of CSS_EASINGS  (deprecated)
    cubicBezierCss(x1,y1,x2,y2)    -> string
    cubicBezier                    -> alias of cubicBezierCss  (deprecated)
    linearPoints(fn, samples?)     -> string  (CSS linear(...))
    easingToCssTimingFunction(input, samples?) -> string

Sequencing:
    sequenceOnTimeline(tracks, opts?) -> Track[]

Export targets:
    toGsap(sb, opts?)              -> string  (GSAP ScrollTrigger + Timeline JS)
    toRig(sb, opts?)               -> string  (lite-scroll-rig-pro JS)

Universal attach (auto-detects native support):
    attachStoryboardRuntime(sb, opts?) -> { detach }

## Design promises

- Single-file ESM (~1750 LOC, ASCII-only source)
- Zero runtime dependencies; optional peers: @zakkster/lite-ease (analytic
  easings), @zakkster/lite-cubic-bezier (bezier runtime), @zakkster/lite-scroll-rig-pro
- Zero-GC hot paths (compositor on native, pre-allocated Float64Array LUTs
  on polyfill, no per-frame regex or string coercion)
- MIT licensed; copyright "Zahary Shinikchiev <shinikchiev@yahoo.com>"

## Storyboard shape

    interface Storyboard {
        timelines?: Record<string, {
            attachedSelector: string,
            kind: 'view' | 'scroll',
            axis?: 'block' | 'inline' | 'x' | 'y',
            scroller?: string
        }>;
        tracks: Track[];
    }

    interface Track {
        selector: string;
        timeline?: { kind?: 'view' | 'scroll', name?: string, axis?, scroller? };
        range?:    { start?: string, end?: string };
        keyframes: Keyframe[];
        easing?:   string | ((t: number) => number);
        fill?:     'none' | 'forwards' | 'backwards' | 'both';
    }

    Keyframes support: opacity, translateX/Y/Z, scale/scaleX/scaleY, rotate,
    plus any CSS property name, plus CSS custom properties (--foo).

## Range endpoint syntax

    'entry 0%' ... 'entry 100%'      element enters the viewport
    'contain 0%' ... 'contain 100%'  element wholly visible
    'exit 0%' ... 'exit 100%'        element leaves the viewport
    'cover 0%' ... 'cover 100%'      full sweep (entry + contain + exit)
    '25%' / '100%'                   bare percentages (any timeline kind)

## Testing (development)

    npm test          # 115 tests, node:test only
    npm run test:gc   # same suite with --expose-gc (zero-GC gate)
